pairs.said: Thanks for calling Gateway Goods, this is Ava. How can I help you today?

pairs.said: I can help with that. Could you please provide the order number? It starts with G W and has five digits.
pairs.heard: I can help with that. Could you please provide the order number? It starts with g w has five digits.

pairs.said: Thank you. Could you also provide the zip code on the order? I need both the order number and zip code to look it up.
pairs.heard: Thank you. Could you also provide the ZIP code on the order? I need both the order number and ZIP code to look it up.

pairs.said: The order number you gave me did not go through because it doesn't match the format we need. Please repeat the order number slowly, one digit at a time, starting with G W.
pairs.heard: The order number you gave me did not go through. Because it doesn't match the format we need. Please repeat the order number slowly. One digit at a time. Starting with g w.
